auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Digistore24 API key sent with the X-DS-API-KEY header. Create it in vendor view under Settings > Account access > API keys: https://help.digistore24.com/hc/en-us/articles/23658595845009-Create-API-key.

actions.name: get_buyer
actions.description: Retrieve details for a Digistore24 buyer.

buyerId.description: Numeric ID of the buyer to retrieve.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for retrieving a Digistore24 buyer.

anyOf.description: Numeric buyer address ID when returned.

addressId.description: Numeric buyer address ID when returned.

anyOf.description: Buyer creation timestamp returned by Digistore24.

createdAt.description: Buyer creation timestamp returned by Digistore24.

anyOf.description: Buyer state or province when returned.

state.description: Buyer state or province when returned.

raw.description: The raw object returned by Digistore24.

actions.name: list_purchases
actions.description: List purchases and sales from the connected Digistore24 account.

from.description: Start time for the purchase list, such as "2014-02-28 23:11:24", "now", "-3d", or "start".

to.description: End time for the purchase list, such as now or a timestamp.

role.description: Comma-separated role filter such as vendor, affiliate, or other.

productId.description: Comma-separated product IDs to filter purchases by.

hasAffiliate.description: Whether to filter purchases by affiliate presence.

purchaseId.description: Comma-separated purchase IDs to filter purchases by.

search.description: Purchase search filters accepted by Digistore24.

loadTransactions.description: Whether to include transactions for each purchase.

pageNo.description: Page number to request. Digistore24 pages start at 1.

pageSize.description: Number of items to request per page.
